# pangolin_health_check_status_history (Data Source)

Daily uptime history of a health check (standalone or attached to a target), oldest day first.

> **Note:** Requires Pangolin Enterprise Edition (written against 1.24.0). The API key needs the `getTarget` action.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Last 30 days of uptime, with day boundaries at UTC+2.
data "pangolin_health_check_status_history" "api" {
  health_check_id   = pangolin_health_check.api.id
  days              = 30
  tz_offset_minutes = 120
}

output "api_uptime_percent" {
  value = data.pangolin_health_check_status_history.api.overall_uptime_percent
}

output "api_bad_days" {
  value = [
    for d in data.pangolin_health_check_status_history.api.history : d.date if d.status == "bad"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `health_check_id` (Number) The health check ID.

### Optional

- `days` (Number) Number of days to return, 1 to 365. The server defaults to 90.
- `tz_offset_minutes` (Number) Minutes added to UTC to anchor the day boundaries (e.g. `120` for UTC+2), -720 to 840. The server defaults to 0 (UTC).

### Read-Only

- `history` (Attributes List) One entry per day. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))
- `overall_uptime_percent` (Number) Uptime over the whole window, 0 to 100.
- `total_downtime_seconds` (Number) Downtime over the whole window, in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `date` (String) Day (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `downtime_windows` (Attributes List) Outage windows of the day. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history--downtime_windows))
- `status` (String) `good`, `degraded`, `bad`, `no_data` or `unknown`.
- `total_downtime_seconds` (Number) Downtime of the day, in seconds.
- `uptime_percent` (Number) Uptime of the day, 0 to 100.

<a id="nestedatt--history--downtime_windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history.downtime_windows`

Read-Only:

- `end` (Number) End (epoch seconds), null while ongoing.
- `start` (Number) Start (epoch seconds).
- `status` (String) Status during the window.
